title: Prove the A4 eight-call floor with arbitrary dirty workspace (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The A4 endpoint `diag([a],[b],[aba^-1b^-1],[ab],1,...,1)` still has exact minimum eight paid calls with **any finite restored dirty workspace**. The new result is a scoped written compression proof, with exact finite corroboration.

```text
hypothetical six-call word on r>=4 roles
  both inherited rank-three floors are tight
  every paid output column lies in the first four roles
  restrict each rank-one idempotent factor to those roles
  obtain the four-role six-call word excluded by #2116/#4032
```

Before, #4032's exact minimum applied to four roles; its written floors already held at every role count. The new step closes the remaining workspace escape. The eight-call corollary retains Cinna Davis #2116's finite four-role exclusion and Sagar Thakrar #4032's radical-rank identities and determinant congruence as cited premises. Their searches and proofs were not audited or replayed for this contribution.

The six-file package is `research/a4-dirty-workspace-minimum/`. Sources are pinned at canonical main `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, priority revision 7. The submission refresh found unchanged guidance and predecessor bytes. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19145499).

## Evidence

Local CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64 checks pass:

- All 29,791 nonzero binary column triples in five dimensions; 26,040 full-rank triples, with both support patterns checked by F4 elimination and a separate binary-span oracle. Exactly 336 triple/support pairs are compatible and confined to the required coordinates.
- All 3,600 admitted single-factor restrictions at role counts 4..7 and 256 additional deterministic words. The 3,856 fixtures check 287,616 complete regular-action basis columns. The eight-call upper-bound fixtures check another 264 columns.
- Nine controls cover seven malformed inputs, a rank-slack counterexample and a required nonzero dirty-input contribution. Two disposable optimized-script mutations, incorrect field inversion and omitted dirty reads, reject. The explicit pivot-inverse invariant was added after the initial rank-only fixtures did not detect that inverse-table mutation.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized registered/direct checks, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight, Ruff 0.17.1 diagnostics and format, official export integrity, and normal/optimized read-only Git-free replay pass. All six exported package files remain unchanged. Each registered command took about 1.2 seconds locally, below its 60-second limit; these are single-run check timings, not performance benchmarks.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/a4-dirty-workspace-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/a4-dirty-workspace-minimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a4-dirty-workspace-minimum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/a4-dirty-workspace-minimum --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 path may replace the local interpreter path. Expected markers include `PASS_A4_DIRTY_WORKSPACE_MINIMUM`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Every verifier run generates a receipt bound to all six package files by SHA256. No receipt is handwritten.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Universal coverage comes from the written rank-saturation and restriction argument. The eight-call corollary depends on the predecessor's finite four-role certificate; a wholly written six-call exclusion is not supplied. The statement uses F2[A4], positive a/b calls and rank-one idempotent couplings. Nilpotent couplings, other fields, alphabets and targets are outside scope.

Native realization, frames, ownership, routing, hosting, precision/tape, stock, recursive costs, compiler and outer admission remain unproved and unpriced. No Lean, Docker, selected cold replay, independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. This is no new kappa or complete multiplication theorem.

## Open next questions

Can the original four-role six-call exclusion be replaced by a wholly written contradiction? Start with compatibility of the two tight rank-three decompositions or the second radical layer. The missing compatibility argument is the blocker. This package does not reserve the question.

## Related open work

- [#5203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5203) proves a four-call minimum for two nonidentity even S4 targets using every odd S4 paid label and arbitrary restored dirty workspace. This package instead uses positive a/b labels in A4 and four specified target roles. These are different alphabets and endpoints; no shared numerical value is compared.
- [#3893](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3893) studies an adjacent S3 register rank floor with a different address group and endpoint; it supplies no competing value for this quantity.
- The completion refresh found nine other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM: #5201, #5202, #5203, #5205, #5206, #5207, #5208, #5209 and #5211. The remaining topics are a signed connector, order-21 and dicyclic targets, a spinor-code relaxation, Gaussian fill, dirty fanout and integer transvections. None studies this four-target A4 endpoint. No additional computations were run to compare other PRs. Sparse cached local notes and unpublished work remain outside exhaustive overlap coverage.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at contribution head `184dbcc0c5340f9b73f6abe988dbaf8b22da0b2b` in [run 39954056514](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39954056514): `plan` in 5m3s and the focused registered package replay in 1m13s. Run metadata confirms the exact head, completed status and conclusion `success`. The registered replay runs the warning-strict normal and optimized checks. Hosted execution is separate from scientific acceptance of the written proof and cited predecessor certificate.

Local registered/direct normal and optimized checks, metadata/pins, exact-head committed-byte/source-history preflight, lint/format, official export integrity and read-only Git-free replays also passed. All six exported package files remained unchanged. No hosted failure remains to report.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. The change adds one isolated research package and touches no shared code, frozen predecessor or selected-frontier record. Archival merging is separate from scientific acceptance.

Cinna Davis #2116 supplies the model, target, direct word and finite four-role exclusion. Retain Cinna Davis #2047/#2248/#2085, juper997 #1478, woklerx #1443, Gareth Davidson #1333, commdata2338 #1414, eumemic #288, Ali Romman #468 and the register-model lineage. Rank saturation and invariant-subspace restriction are classical linear algebra. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Apache-2.0.
